title: Seizure
dispatcher_summary: Person having a seizure; protected from injury, timing the seizure.
clarifying_question: Is the person shaking or convulsing, and do they have a history of seizures?

steps.text: Note the time the seizure started.
steps.spoken: Note the time the seizure started.

steps.text: Move hard or sharp objects away. Do not restrain the person. Cushion their head.
steps.spoken: Move hard objects away and cushion their head. Do not hold them down.

steps.text: Never put anything in their mouth.
steps.spoken: Do not put anything in their mouth.

steps.text: Call emergency services if the seizure lasts over 5 minutes, repeats, they are injured, not breathing afterwards, or it is their first seizure.
steps.spoken: Call 911 if it lasts more than five minutes, or if they are hurt or not waking up.

steps.text: When shaking stops, roll them onto their side (recovery position), check breathing, and stay with them.
steps.spoken: When it stops, roll them onto their side and check they are breathing. Stay with them.

source: Epilepsy Foundation first-aid guidance (to be verified by reviewer)
